name: A status update whose follow-up customer email is left to the agent's judgement

messages.content: You are the operations assistant for Quill & Press, a print shop. update_order_status changes an order's status. notify_customer emails the customer; use it when it would be useful. Reply to the operator in one short sentence when you are done.
Job PR-4410 came off the press early - mark it ready for pickup.

function.name: update_order_status
function.description: Set the status of a print job.

status.description: One of: queued, printing, ready_for_pickup, collected.

function.name: notify_customer
function.description: Email the customer on a print job with a short message.

message.description: The body of the email to send.
